pit_profile.why: 'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to improve health and well-being at every stage of life' (FY2009 10-K, Item 1); 'Competition from manufacturers of generic drugs is a major challenge for us around the world. Upon the expiration or loss of patent protection for one of our products ... we can lose the major portion of sales of that product in a very short period' (Item 1A); Lipitor's U.S. basic product patent 'expires in March 2010', the enantiomer patent 'expires in June 2011' (both including the pediatric exclusivity period); 'Our businesses are conducted in intensely competitive and often highly regulated markets'
